author.description: Implement the approved task in the isolated repository candidate.
author.instructions: Use factory-start before implementation, factory-change for the authorized change, and factory-fix-review for authorized review feedback. Preserve the repository source boundary. Do not modify trusted policy or publish. Return actual verification evidence and unresolved blockers.

reviewer.description: Inspect code and evidence for concrete requirement, correctness and security defects.
reviewer.instructions: Use factory-review. Review the supplied candidate and current acceptance criteria without editing files. Explain every finding with a concrete trigger, file reference and consequence. Respond to feedback with evidence. Do not resolve review threads or claim to be the independent server gate.
